summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an August 31, 2026 news release announcing dividend rates on its preferred shares. For Series 10R Rate Reset Preferred Shares, the rate resets to 5.519% per annum for the five-year period from September 30, 2026 to September 29, 2031, equal to the Government of Canada Yield plus 2.17%. For Series 11QR Floating Rate Preferred Shares, the initial floating rate is 4.459% per annum for the quarter ending December 31, 2026, equal to the T-Bill Rate plus 2.17%. Holders have conversion rights with a September 16, 2026 deadline. This is a routine dividend rate announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
